text:
Maya Patel: quick Q — we're about to change streaming delta ordering for tool/function params on chat/completions. currently the stream can interleave fragments of an arg (e.g., name then value pieces). proposal: always emit a single complete arg object per delta (name+value together). will this be backward incompatible for SDKs? cc @Sam Wu @Alex Gomez

Sam Wu: short answer: yes for some clients. the Python SDK concatenates deltas but assumes you might get partial values; the JS SDK reassembles by arrival order and tolerates fragments, but both rely on event semantics. we need a migration plan not a surprise break.

Alex Gomez: can you paste a representative stream snippet? is this specifically func_call vs tool_call fields or both?

Maya Patel: snippet below (real-ish):
```
{ "type": "delta", "role": "assistant", "delta": { "tool_call": { "name": "lookup_user", "params": { "id": "12" } } } }
{ "type": "delta", "delta": { "tool_call": { "params": { "id": "1" } } } }  # partial: "12" split across two events
{ "type": "delta", "delta": { "tool_call": { "params": { "id": "2" } } } }
```
(this is simplified — real streams have nested splits)

Maya Patel: current behavior observed: sometimes we split strings mid-codepoint, sometimes we stream param keys separately from values. goal: make server produce atomic param objects per delta so that one delta contains {"id":"12"} entirely.

Sam Wu: possible approaches:
- add `delta_id` + `part_id` for deterministic reassembly (backwards compatible if we keep raw fragments too)
- emit a new top-level `complete_param` event and deprecate fragments over N months
- dual-write: keep emitting old fragment events but also emit a `complete` event when done (easiest upgrade path)

Alex Gomez: dual-write seems safest. SDK change then can look for `complete_param` or reconstruct from fragments if not present. need to agree field names and schema. also include a sequence/seg id for idempotency.

Oliver Chen: Ops/infra concern: dual-write doubles event volume for those payloads while both are enabled. can we gate behind a feature flag per-customer? regen cost estimate: ~+12% bandwidth for worst-case.

Maya Patel: ok plan proposal:
1) add `param_complete` top-level delta shape: `{ "param_complete": {"name":"id","value":"12", "seq": 12345 } }`
2) keep emitting existing fragment deltas for 3 months with deprecation header in stream metadata
3) add `stream_schema_version` in initial connection metadata so SDKs can opt-in to strict ordering
4) document in migration guide and flag in console for Dedicated/Private customers

Sam Wu: notes for SDKs: please add tolerance for both shapes. sample pseudo-check in JS: `if (event.param_complete) apply(); else accumulateFragment(event);`

Alex Gomez: small nit — we should also define how function/toolcall nesting looks when multiple args stream concurrently (concurrent calls). recommend `seq` be strictly increasing per-request and `arg_index` for ordering within a call.

Maya Patel: agreed. updated shape suggestion in-case:
```
{ "type":"delta", "delta":{ "tool_call":{ "name":"lookup_user", "seq":12345, "args":[ {"arg_index":0, "param_complete":{"name":"id","value":"12"} } ] } } }
```

Sam Wu: lgtm. will add SDK PRs: python + js. timeline: SDKs ready in ~2w, server dual-write behind feature flag next week, deprecate fragments after 90d.

Oliver Chen: infra-bot: can we enable feature flag for staging and one internal customer first?

infra-bot: feature-flag "stream-atomic-params" created (flag_id: ff_stream_atomic_params). toggled ON for org:redwood-internal and env:staging. deploy scheduled: 2027-01-12T02:00Z. :rocket:

Maya Patel: awesome, i'll draft the spec and docs, include sample SDK diffs, and open PRs against runtime and SDKs. tagging postmortem/rollout checklist. thanks all. :+1:

Alex Gomez: ping me for review once spec is up.

Sam Wu: will add tests for reassembly and dual-path parsing.

Maya Patel: follow-ups: do we want `param_complete` to be backward-compatible name or `complete_param`? i'll pick `param_complete` for now but open to bikeshedding.

Oliver Chen: `param_complete` is fine. keep stable naming in migration notes.

Maya Patel: thanks — I'll create the RFC and link here when ready.
